en: n. medical treatment in which a doctor cuts open a part of the body; the branch of medicine that deals with this; a place where a doctor performs operations
ex: He needs surgery on his knee after the accident.
他在意外後需要動膝蓋手術。

en: n. an official document given by a school or college to show that a person has completed a course of study
ex: She received her diploma at the graduation ceremony.
她在畢業典禮上領到了畢業證書。

en: vt. to prevent someone from doing what they want; to make someone feel upset or annoyed because they cannot achieve something; to cause a plan to fail
ex: The long delays frustrated all the passengers.
漫長的延誤讓所有乘客感到沮喪。

en: vt. to make someone feel very shocked, frightened or disgusted
ex: The news of the accident horrified the whole town.
那起意外的消息讓整個鎮上的人都震驚了。

en: vt. to surround something or put a barrier around it; to put something inside an envelope together with a letter; to include something with a letter
ex: Please enclose a copy of your résumé with your application.
請在申請書中附上你的履歷。

en: n. a feeling of worry or fear about something that might happen; a state of being nervous; something that causes worry
ex: She felt great anxiety before her job interview.
面試前她感到非常焦慮。

en: a. unable to pay your debts; n. a person who cannot pay their debts; vt. to make someone or something unable to pay debts
ex: The company went bankrupt after losing its biggest customer.
公司在失去最大客戶後破產了。

en: n. a short, memorable phrase used in advertising or politics; a phrase that expresses the aims of a group
ex: The company's new slogan is easy to remember.
公司的新口號很容易記。

en: n. a group of people chosen to make decisions or give advice for a town, city or organization; a meeting of such a group
ex: The city council voted to build a new park.
市議會投票通過興建新公園。

en: n. a first version of a piece of writing or a plan that is not yet finished; a flow of cool air in a room; a written order for payment of money; vt. to write a first version of something; to order someone to join the army
ex: I've written a first draft of my essay.
我已經寫好論文的初稿。

en: vt. to stop something from continuing; vi. to stop moving or doing something; n. a stop in movement or activity; a short stop on a journey
ex: The police officer raised his hand to halt the traffic.
警察舉手叫車流停下。

en: n. a student in the first year of high school or university in the United States; a person who is new at something
ex: As a freshman, he was nervous about living away from home.
身為大一新生，他對於離家居住感到緊張。

en: a. connected with the countryside rather than the city; relating to farming or country life
ex: They moved to a quiet rural village in the north.
他們搬到北方一個安靜的鄉下村莊。

en: n. something that you give or do to help achieve something; an amount of money that you give to a person or organization; an article or story written for a newspaper or magazine
ex: Her contribution to the project was very important.
她對這個專案的貢獻非常重要。

en: vi. to talk with someone, especially in a friendly way; n. the opposite of something; a. opposite or reversed in position or meaning
ex: They conversed for hours about politics.
他們談了好幾個小時的政治。

en: vt. to make something new again; to continue something after a pause; to extend the period during which a document is valid; vi. to begin again
ex: I need to renew my driver's license next month.
我下個月需要換新駕照。

en: n. an agreement between two people about the price of something; something that is sold for less than its usual price; v. to talk about the price of something to get a lower price; to negotiate
ex: This jacket was a real bargain at half price.
這件夾克半價買真是撿到便宜。

en: a. thinking about the needs of other people; kind and considerate; showing careful thought
ex: It was very thoughtful of you to send me a card.
你寄卡片給我，真是太貼心了。

en: n. a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something; great eagerness to do something
ex: She showed great enthusiasm for her new job.
她對新工作表現出極大的熱忱。

en: vt. to show someone or something in a painting or drawing; to describe someone or something in a particular way; to act the part of a person in a play or film
ex: The film portrays the life of a famous scientist.
這部電影描繪了一位著名科學家的生平。

en: vt. to make something easier to understand by explaining it; to make a liquid clear by removing unwanted substances; vi. to become clear
ex: Could you clarify what you mean by that?
你可以釐清一下你的意思嗎？

en: v. to make something seem larger, better or worse than it really is; to describe something as bigger or more important than it is
ex: He tends to exaggerate when he tells stories.
他講故事時往往會誇大。

en: n. a rule or condition that limits something; a limit on the amount of something; a weakness or something you cannot do
ex: There is a limitation on the number of guests allowed.
受邀賓客人數有限制。

en: n. a pause before doing something because you are not sure about it; the act of hesitating; a stop or pause when speaking
ex: She accepted the job offer without hesitation.
她毫不猶豫就接受了這份工作。

en: n. an event, especially an unusual or unpleasant one; a small event that is not very important; a. likely to happen as a result of something
ex: The police are investigating the incident near the station.
警方正在調查車站附近發生的事件。

en: n. a list of times when buses, trains or planes leave and arrive; a plan showing the times when events will happen; a list of the times of school lessons
ex: I checked the train timetable before leaving.
出門前我查了火車時刻表。

en: n. a slow-moving land reptile with a hard round shell on its back; a very slow person
ex: The tortoise walked slowly across the garden.
烏龜慢慢走過花園。

en: vt. to touch someone lightly to make them laugh; to cause a slight itch; to please or amuse someone; vi. to feel an itch; n. a light touch that makes someone laugh; a slight itch
ex: He tickled the baby's feet and made her giggle.
他搔嬰兒的腳，把她逗得咯咯笑。

en: n. a very sad event or situation that causes great suffering; a serious play with a sad ending; a series of sad events
ex: The loss of so many lives was a terrible tragedy.
如此多人喪生是一場可怕的悲劇。

en: n. the act of working with others to achieve a shared aim; willingness to help or work with someone
ex: Thank you for your cooperation during the inspection.
感謝你在檢查期間的配合。

en: a. real and specific rather than general or abstract; made of a hard building material; n. a hard building material made by mixing cement, sand, water and small stones; v. to cover something with concrete
ex: We need concrete evidence before we can make a decision.
我們需要具體的證據才能做決定。

en: n. the most important city in a country, where the government is based; a large letter used at the beginning of a name or sentence; money used to start a business; a. very important; (of a letter) written in uppercase
ex: Taipei is the capital of Taiwan.
台北是台灣的首都。

en: a. having parts that are very close together; (of fog or smoke) so thick that it is hard to see through; (informal) stupid
ex: The dense fog made it difficult to drive.
濃霧使開車變得很困難。

en: prep. containing something as part of a whole; used to introduce an example or list
ex: All the students, including me, passed the exam.
包括我在內，所有學生都通過了考試。

en: a. easily frightened; lacking in courage or confidence; shy and nervous
ex: The timid child hid behind her mother.
那個膽小的孩子躲在媽媽背後。

en: n. an official document that gives you permission to do or own something; vt. to give someone official permission to do something
ex: You need a license to drive a car in this country.
在這個國家，開車需要駕照。

en: n. a change made to improve a system, law or institution; vt. to make improvements to something; vi. to improve your behavior
ex: The government plans to reform the education system.
政府計畫改革教育體系。

en: n. the main long thin part of a plant that carries leaves, flowers or fruit; the thin part of a glass; vt. to stop something from spreading or flowing; vi. to come from or be caused by something
ex: She cut the flower stem at an angle.
她把花莖斜斜剪斷。

en: n. a large bird of prey with sharp claws and strong eyesight; a person who supports war or aggressive policies; vi. to hunt with a hawk; to clear the throat noisily; vt. to sell goods in the street
ex: A hawk circled above the field looking for mice.
一隻鷹在田野上盤旋尋找老鼠。

en: a. important and well known; easy to see or notice; sticking out from a surface
ex: He is a prominent lawyer in the city.
他是這座城市中一位知名律師。
